title: Seven weeks at the World's Fair with Jo Jones
summary: He led a trio with Jo Jones at the World's Fair while Danny Barker played across the street.

story.theme_name: Still working: current gigs, upcoming projects and plans
story.community_name: What's next: upcoming tours, records and plans

blocks.x: You hadn't mentioned the World's Fair before. Say a little bit about that.

Well I worked the World's Fair when they had Jo Jones on drums. It was a trio and at one time I had Jackie Williams and I did that. And Danny Barker was across the Street at the Louisiana Pavilion. And so I did about six or seven, seven weeks there at the World's Fair.

Ohh, let's see what was that pavilion? I was in the same area, but this particular place I was playing, what was that called? Anyway, I forgot what the name of that was called, but that was right in that area and Danny was right across the street. He had a thing, there were guitars and they were doin' that New Orleans thing, you know. A fine person. And so I did that and that
was quite an experience, the World's Fair. Yeah.
